data.note: Rework rate is measured from the bug label, which covers planned fixes as well as reactions to incidents. It is reported but not used to place the project.

practices.name: Spec (Gherkin)
practices.description: Acceptance behaviour is written as Gherkin scenarios and executed on every build.
practices.reason: Expected but absent: no workflow on the default branch runs it and no facet reports it.

practices.name: Tests & coverage
practices.description: API and web tests run on every build with a minimum coverage per module.

practices.name: Mutation score
practices.description: Mutation testing proves the tests assert, held above a minimum score.
practices.reason: Runs report-only, where an enforced threshold is expected.

practices.name: Vulnerabilities (deps & IaC)
practices.description: Dependencies and infrastructure as code are scanned; critical and high findings block.

practices.name: Insecure patterns (SAST)
practices.description: Static analysis for insecure code patterns blocks on errors.

practices.name: SBOM & licenses
practices.description: A software bill of materials is produced and licences are checked against policy.

practices.name: Complexity
practices.description: A cyclomatic complexity and CRAP gate stops new hotspots.

practices.name: DAST
practices.description: The deployed test environment is scanned dynamically for vulnerabilities.
practices.reason: Expected but absent: no workflow on the default branch runs it and no facet reports it.

practices.name: Performance
practices.description: Load tests against the test environment hold response times within budget. Only when the project requires it.
practices.reason: Only expected when required; opt in with scorecard.performance in projects.json.

alerts.message: High AI usage, low engineering: AI usage is 4/5 while the engineering level is N1, so AI-assisted change lands without the gates that would catch its mistakes.

warnings.message: 10 of 58 agent run(s) had no readable usage artifact. Artifacts expire after about 90 days, and a run still in progress has not uploaded one yet.
